title: It's not so long ago when AAA games looked like this and now AI agents can create it in one shot of pure code... 🤯
author: Cool-Chemical-5629
selftext:
Honestly, I am impressed guys. I did not expect to see this after ONE prompt! All you see in this screenshot is done with pure code. 🤯  
  
There are multiple arenas, multiple mounts you can fly and I saw volumetric clouds in a different arena. This is so cool! It's a singleplayer game where you're flying different mounts and fighting opponents in different arenas while fulfilling some objectives. As you progress through different stages of the tournament, you earn points which you can use to unlock various enhancements and skills.

comments.body: Ai agents are impressive... But lets be real if that dragon model was the centre of a 1998 game people would laugh at it back then. Look at the spyro model and then look at that dragon.

replies.author: Cool-Chemical-5629
replies.body:
I never said it's perfect, but let's be real, the large language models were not able to create a 3D model just a few years ago, let alone a 3D model of a dragon. Now they can create simple models like this in one shot even though they were never built to do that as they are just language models and not dedicated 3D model creators.

My point is that in just couple of years we went from "Sorry, I can't help you with that" to something which can create a game in one shot and make it look and play almost like a game from around 2000s. At this rate, in couple of years large language models may be capable enough to create modern looking games, maybe even without help of external tools.

replies.author: cxfoulke
replies.body:
Well the issue is... Can ai make a working prototype it's actually been able to do that for a while now. Just the amount of effort has reduced. 

The real thing is can ai make the next step of being able to do the last 10% of polish that turns dumpster trash into a really good game. 

It hasn't really progressed at that. 

The complexity of understanding a consistent art style, animation styles and making micro adjustments to content to polish it to perfection. 

Is actually far greater than going from zero to simple shapes dragon.
